mapper.select: select u.id as userId, u.username, u.avatar, cm.message as lastMessage, cm.create_time from xg_chat_message cm left join xg_user u on u.id = cm.sender_id and u.del_flag = 0 where cm.del_flag = 0 and cm.receiver_id = #{userId} order by cm.create_time

select hc.id as chatMessageId, hc.sender_id, hc.receiver_id, hc.message, hc.chat_type, hc.message_type, hc.create_time, hc.withdrawn, hc.edited, hc.edit_time, hc.reply_to_id as replyToId, hc.reply_content as replyContent, hc.at_users as atUsers, mr.is_read from ( select id, sender_id, receiver_id, message, chat_type, message_type, create_time, withdrawn, edited, edit_time, reply_to_id, reply_content, at_users, del_flag from xg_chat_message where del_flag = 0 and chat_type = 1 and (sender_id = #{senderId} and receiver_id = #{receiverId} or sender_id = #{receiverId} and receiver_id = #{senderId}) union all select id, sender_id, receiver_id, message, chat_type, message_type, create_time, withdrawn, edited, edit_time, reply_to_id, reply_content, at_users, del_flag from xg_chat_message_archive where del_flag = 0 and chat_type = 1 and (sender_id = #{senderId} and receiver_id = #{receiverId} or sender_id = #{receiverId} and receiver_id = #{senderId}) ) hc left join xg_message_read mr on mr.message_id = hc.id and mr.receiver_id = hc.receiver_id where hc.del_flag = 0 order by hc.create_time desc, hc.id desc

select cm.id, cm.sender_id, cm.receiver_id, cm.message, cm.del_flag, cm.create_by, cm.create_time, cm.update_by, cm.update_time from xg_chat_message cm where cm.del_flag = 0 and cm.sender_id = #{senderId} and cm.receiver_id = #{receiverId} order by cm.create_time desc limit 1

select hc.id as chatMessageId, hc.sender_id, hc.receiver_id, hc.message, hc.chat_type, hc.message_type, hc.create_time, hc.withdrawn, hc.edited, hc.edit_time, hc.reply_to_id as replyToId, hc.reply_content as replyContent, hc.at_users as atUsers, mr.is_read from ( select id, sender_id, receiver_id, message, chat_type, message_type, create_time, withdrawn, edited, edit_time, reply_to_id, reply_content, at_users, del_flag from xg_chat_message where del_flag = 0 and chat_type = 2 and receiver_id = #{groupId} union all select id, sender_id, receiver_id, message, chat_type, message_type, create_time, withdrawn, edited, edit_time, reply_to_id, reply_content, at_users, del_flag from xg_chat_message_archive where del_flag = 0 and chat_type = 2 and receiver_id = #{groupId} ) hc left join xg_message_read mr on mr.message_id = hc.id and mr.receiver_id = #{userId} and mr.del_flag = 0 where hc.del_flag = 0 order by hc.create_time desc, hc.id desc

select cm.id as chatMessageId, cm.sender_id, cm.receiver_id, cm.message, cm.chat_type, cm.create_time, cm.withdrawn, cm.edited, cm.edit_time, cm.reply_to_id as replyToId, cm.reply_content as replyContent, cm.at_users as atUsers from xg_chat_message cm where cm.del_flag = 0 and cm.chat_type = 3 and (cm.sender_id = #{userId} and cm.receiver_id = #{botId} or cm.sender_id = #{botId} and cm.receiver_id = #{userId}) order by cm.create_time desc

select cm.id, cm.sender_id, cm.receiver_id, cm.message, cm.del_flag, cm.create_by, cm.create_time, cm.update_by, cm.update_time from xg_chat_message cm where cm.del_flag = 0 and cm.sender_id = #{senderId} and cm.receiver_id = #{receiverId} order by cm.create_time desc limit 1

select cm.id, cm.sender_id, cm.receiver_id, cm.message, cm.del_flag, cm.create_by, cm.create_time, cm.update_by, cm.update_time from xg_chat_message cm where cm.del_flag = 0 and cm.receiver_id = #{groupId} order by cm.create_time desc limit 1

select t.peer_id as peerId, t.chat_type as chatType, t.message, t.create_time as createTime from ( select m.message, m.chat_type, m.create_time, case when m.chat_type = 1 then if(m.sender_id = #{userId}, m.receiver_id, m.sender_id) else m.receiver_id end as peer_id, row_number() over ( partition by case when m.chat_type = 1 then if(m.sender_id = #{userId}, m.receiver_id, m.sender_id) else m.receiver_id end, m.chat_type order by m.create_time desc, m.id desc ) as rn from xg_chat_message m where m.del_flag = 0 and (m.withdrawn is null or m.withdrawn = 0) and ( (m.chat_type in (1, 3) and (m.sender_id = #{userId} or m.receiver_id = #{userId})) or (m.chat_type = 2 and ( m.sender_id = #{userId} or m.receiver_id in ( select gm.group_id from xg_group_member gm where gm.user_id = #{userId} and gm.status = 1 and gm.del_flag = 0 ) )) ) ) t where t.rn = 1
select g.id, g.group_name as groupName, g.group_avatar as groupAvatar, g.current_member as currentMember from xg_group g where g.id = #{groupId} and g.del_flag = 0

select count(1) from xg_chat_message m left join xg_call_record_seen s on s.user_id = #{userId} where m.del_flag = 0 and m.chat_type = 1 and m.receiver_id = #{userId} and (m.withdrawn is null or m.withdrawn = 0) and (m.message_type = 9 or (m.message_type = 6 and m.message like '%"kind":"video"%')) and m.create_time > coalesce(s.last_seen_time, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') and json_unquote(json_extract(m.message, '$.outcome')) in ('rejected', 'timeout', 'busy') and not exists ( select 1 from xg_call_record_deleted d where d.user_id = #{userId} and d.message_id = m.id )
mapper.insert: insert into xg_call_record_seen(user_id, last_seen_time) values (#{userId}, now()) on duplicate key update last_seen_time = now()

insert ignore into xg_call_record_deleted(user_id, message_id, create_time) select #{userId}, m.id, now() from xg_chat_message m where m.id = #{messageId} and m.del_flag = 0 and m.chat_type = 1 and (m.sender_id = #{userId} or m.receiver_id = #{userId}) and (m.message_type = 9 or (m.message_type = 6 and m.message like '%"kind":"video"%'))

insert ignore into xg_call_record_deleted(user_id, message_id, create_time) select #{userId}, m.id, now() from xg_chat_message m where m.del_flag = 0 and m.chat_type = 1 and (m.sender_id = #{userId} or m.receiver_id = #{userId}) and (m.withdrawn is null or m.withdrawn = 0) and (m.message_type = 9 or (m.message_type = 6 and m.message like '%"kind":"video"%'))
